description: This Java class implements the <field-to-result> element for a mini-language processing framework, handling mapping of fields to results within method execution context.

classes.name: FieldToResult
classes.description: Implements the <field-to-result> element, mapping a field value to a result map within method execution.

classes.name: FieldToResultFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating instances of FieldToResult.

methods.name: FieldToResult
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the object based on XML element attributes, validating attributes and setting up map accessors.

methods.name: exec
methods.description: Executes the operation: retrieves a field value, evaluates nested expressions if needed, and stores the value in the results map.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the object, mainly for debugging.

methods.name: createMethodOperation
methods.description: Factory method to create a new FieldToResult instance.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the operation, 'field-to-result'.
